findings.highlight: she is lying on the floor
findings.evidenceJa: 畳であお向けになっている
findings.governingReading: she is lying face-up on the tatami
findings.explanation: The precise supine posture and tatami surface become generic floor-lying.

findings.highlight: She was sick
findings.evidenceJa: 風邪ぎみだっていうのに
findings.governingReading: although she was showing signs of a cold
findings.explanation: A qualified mild condition becomes the categorical and broader “sick.”

findings.highlight: helped around with my house
findings.evidenceJa: うちの手伝い
findings.governingReading: helping with the work of the Emiya household
findings.explanation: Sakura’s participation in shared household labor is made to sound like service performed on Shirou’s property.

findings.highlight: I go past the living room, trying not to wake her up.
findings.evidenceJa: 桜を起こさないように居間を横切る
findings.governingReading: he crosses the living room without waking Sakura
findings.explanation: Motion through the room is relocated to passing outside or beside it.

findings.highlight: I carefully drape the blanket over her.
findings.evidenceJa: 静かに、寝た子を起こさないように毛布をかける
findings.governingReading: he quietly covers her so as not to wake the sleeping girl
findings.explanation: The explicit acoustic care and purpose become generic carefulness.

findings.highlight: empty eyes
findings.evidenceJa: 心ここにあらずという目
findings.governingReading: eyes suggesting her mind is elsewhere
findings.explanation: Drowsy mental absence is strengthened into vacant or lifeless eyes.

findings.highlight: her gesture is more erotic
findings.evidenceJa: 色っぽい仕草だった
findings.governingReading: the gesture is more sensual or alluring than anything he has seen from her
findings.explanation: “Erotic” makes Shirou’s interpretation cruder and more explicit than the source’s sensuality.

findings.highlight: Umher gesture
findings.evidenceJa: その今まで見たこともないぐらい
findings.governingReading: um, a gesture
findings.explanation: A missing boundary visibly fuses “Um” and “her.”

findings.highlight: Nervously, I try to explain myself.
findings.evidenceJa: ひどく落ち着かなくなって言い訳をする
findings.governingReading: thoroughly unsettled, Shirou makes an excuse
findings.explanation: The self-aware excuse becomes neutral explanation.

findings.highlight: Sakura’s arms wrap around my neck.
findings.evidenceJa: ふわりと、桜の腕が、俺の首に巻きついてきた
findings.governingReading: Sakura’s arms softly curl around Shirou’s neck
findings.explanation: The light, drifting quality of the involuntary-looking movement disappears.

findings.highlight: I’m intensely aware of her femininity
findings.evidenceJa: 首に伸ばされた指
findings.governingReading: the fingers extended around his neck
findings.explanation: Concrete bodily staging is replaced by abstract awareness of femininity.

findings.highlight: I’m intensely aware of her femininity, no matter how hard I try to ignore it.
findings.evidenceJa: もう目の前にある女の体が、否応なしに視界に飛び込んでくる
findings.governingReading: the woman’s body directly before him forces itself into his field of vision
findings.explanation: The source’s involuntary visual framing becomes an unsupported claim that Shirou actively tries to ignore abstract femininity.

findings.highlight: I can’t take my eyes off of her.
findings.evidenceJa: 目が、桜の体から離れない
findings.governingReading: his eyes will not leave Sakura’s body
findings.explanation: The specific object of Shirou’s compromised gaze is generalized to Sakura as a person.

findings.highlight: Her hair streams down her neck.
findings.evidenceJa: 首筋から流れる髪
findings.governingReading: hair slips loose from the nape of her neck
findings.explanation: The hair’s release from the neckline is changed into downward streaming along the neck.

findings.highlight: her breasts are pushing up her shirt
findings.evidenceJa: 大きく張り詰めた胸元
findings.governingReading: her full, taut chest
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents the clothing interaction and makes the description more explicitly anatomical.

findings.highlight: her mature woman’s body
findings.evidenceJa: 知らないうちに成長した体
findings.governingReading: the body that matured without Shirou noticing
findings.explanation: The unsettling realization that Sakura grew up outside Shirou’s awareness disappears.

findings.highlight: Her hands tense up a bit.
findings.evidenceJa: 首にかけられた手に、僅かな力が篭る
findings.governingReading: the hands around his neck gain a little strength
findings.explanation: The location and enclosing relation of Sakura’s hands disappear.

findings.highlight: Our faces near each other.
findings.evidenceJa: 顔が近づく
findings.governingReading: a face draws closer
findings.explanation: Ambiguous approach is rewritten as explicitly mutual movement.

findings.highlight: such boring senses are being destroyed
findings.evidenceJa: そんなつまらない良識が、壊れていく
findings.governingReading: that supposedly trivial good sense or moral restraint is breaking down
findings.explanation: Ethical restraint becomes sensory perception, obscuring the boundary Shirou knows he should maintain.

findings.highlight: everything I shouldn’t have noticed
findings.evidenceJa: これからも気付いてはいけないこと
findings.governingReading: what he must not allow himself to notice from now on
findings.explanation: A continuing prospective prohibition is shifted into regret about a past discovery.

findings.highlight: The sound of the pounding heart
findings.evidenceJa: 痛いとさえ思える心音
findings.governingReading: heartbeats so forceful they seem painful
findings.explanation: The physical extremity of Shirou’s heartbeat disappears.

findings.highlight: land on top of the table
findings.evidenceJa: 油断なくテーブルの上に着地する
findings.governingReading: lands on the table without an opening or lapse in guard
findings.explanation: The mock-combat precision completing the training gag disappears.

findings.highlight: I was a bit surprised.
findings.evidenceJa: 気が動転してた
findings.governingReading: he was flustered or panicked
findings.explanation: Shirou’s disorientation is weakened into mild surprise.

findings.highlight: Her hands are lowered
findings.evidenceJa: 伸ばしていた両手をぱたんと床に落として
findings.governingReading: both outstretched hands fall to the floor with a soft plop
findings.explanation: The involuntary fall, prior reaching posture, bilateral action, and sound cue are all flattened into a passive lowered position.

findings.highlight: I am well rested and in perfect condition.
findings.evidenceJa: 昨日の休息で私の体調も万全
findings.governingReading: yesterday’s rest has restored Saber to perfect condition
findings.explanation: The specific recovery interval linking Saber’s condition to the previous day disappears.

findings.highlight: I would kill myself
findings.evidenceJa: 腹を切ってたところだぞ
findings.governingReading: he would have cut open his stomach
findings.explanation: The culturally and physically specific exaggerated seppuku image becomes generic suicide.

findings.highlight: I would kill myself out of shame.
findings.evidenceJa: 申し訳なくて腹を切ってた
findings.governingReading: he would have felt so unforgivably apologetic toward Sakura that he would cut his stomach
findings.explanation: Shirou’s imagined self-punishment for wronging Sakura is reframed as private embarrassment or shame.
